question: Books that contain the records of Christ's life are known as __________.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Gospels**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first of the four **New Testament Gospels**, which detail the life and death of Jesus Christ, is the Gospel of Matthew.
 
• Along with the Gospels of Mark and Luke, it is one of the so-called **Synoptic Gospels** (i.e., those presenting a common view).
 
• The poem describes St. Matthew the **Evangelist**, one of the Twelve Apostles and a tax collector, as the author (10:3).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• It is obvious that the **Gospel** According to Mark, which came before it. 
 
• It had an impact on the Gospel According to Matthew, which was written in **Greek**, most likely after 70 CE.
 
• Regarding the plausibility of an earlier **Aramaic translation**, there has been significant discussion. Several literary cues point to books.
